programs.description: Global development and humanitarian assistance programs including PEPFAR (HIV/AIDS), food security, democracy promotion, and disaster relief across 100+ countries.
Diversity, equity, and inclusion offices across all federal agencies, including training programs, reporting requirements, and dedicated staff positions.
Clean Air Act and Clean Water Act enforcement, emissions standards, and environmental monitoring programs. Reduced scope under energy deregulation orders.
CBP operations, border wall construction, surveillance technology, and additional border patrol agent hiring. Significantly expanded under border security EOs.
Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations including interior enforcement, detention facilities (private and federal), and deportation flights. Detention costs ~$150/day per detainee.
US assessed and voluntary contributions to the World Health Organization for global health security, pandemic preparedness, and disease surveillance.
US commitments under the Paris Climate Agreement including Green Climate Fund contributions and bilateral climate finance to developing nations.
President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief — the largest global health program in history. Provides antiretroviral treatment to 20M+ people across 50+ countries. At risk under foreign aid review.
Reclassification of up to 50,000 federal employees from career civil service to at-will 'Schedule F' positions, removing job protections for policy-influencing roles.
Department of Government Efficiency initiative to identify waste and reduce federal spending. Claims $2T in potential savings; independent estimates suggest $55B over 10 years is more realistic.
Federal refugee admissions and resettlement program including housing, job training, and social services for legally admitted refugees. Admissions reduced from 125,000 to near zero.
IRA-funded clean energy tax credits, DOE loan programs, and renewable energy research grants. Some programs paused or defunded under energy emergency declaration.
OFCCP contractor compliance, EEOC affirmative action enforcement, and federal contractor diversity requirements. Executive orders rescinded requirements dating to the 1960s.
New subsidies and regulatory relief for coal-fired power plants designated as critical to national defense. Includes exemptions from emissions standards and grid priority mandates.
Expedited permitting for oil, gas, and mineral extraction on federal lands in Alaska including ANWR. Fast-tracks environmental reviews and opens previously protected areas.
Military and law enforcement operations against cartels designated as Foreign Terrorist Organizations. Includes expanded intelligence operations, sanctions enforcement, and cross-border operations.
DOJ resources dedicated to defending birthright citizenship restrictions in federal courts. Multiple injunctions issued; cases heading to Supreme Court.
